I read all 132 lines of BranchSeparation.lean. I also searched the CoulombTransport directory for other places that use `Separated`, `measurableSet_le measurable_const` and `components K H`, to see whether the file repeats reasoning found elsewhere.

I found no nontrivial reasoning that is repeated across proofs in a way that a shared lemma would clearly improve:
- `isCompact_iUnion (compact_components hK hcont)` appears in both `ae_mem_branchMarginal_components` (line 72) and `compact_support_and_separation` (line 101). It is a single call to an existing API lemma, so it is a thin wrapper and not machinery worth extracting.
- `compact_components` (line 22) and `disjoint_components_mono` (line 112) both use `Fin.cases` on the definition of `components`. Each is a one-line case split.
- The repeated steps inside `exists_ae_separated_branchCoupling` (the bounds from the central set and between the outer images, used for both branches) are already shared through the local helpers `hcentral` and `houter`.
- In `ae_mem_branchMarginal_components`, `hcentral`/`houter` are short `filter_upwards`/`ae_map_iff` steps, and `houter` is already parameterised over `i`.
- The measurability proof for `Separated` sets (`measurableSet_separated`) appears only in this file. No other file in the directory proves measurability of the `Separated` set again.
- `finite_cost_branchCoupling` reuses `exists_ae_separated_branchCoupling` and `CoulombEstimates.lintegral_coulombCost_lt_top_of_ae_separated` instead of repeating their arguments.

Remaining uncertainty: I did not check other parts of the OAI tree outside CoulombTransport for duplicate proofs of `Separated`-set measurability. Under this rubric, though, a duplicate elsewhere would be a finding against that other file, not this one.
